supply_agreements_payee_columns_ck.name: supply_agreements_payee_columns_ck
supply_agreements_payee_columns_ck.value:
("supply_agreements"."payee" = 'sponsor' and "supply_agreements"."sponsor_id" is not null and "supply_agreements"."supplier_id" is not null and "supply_agreements"."worker_id" is null)
       or ("supply_agreements"."payee" = 'middleman' and "supply_agreements"."supplier_id" is not null and "supply_agreements"."worker_id" is null)
       or ("supply_agreements"."payee" = 'worker' and "supply_agreements"."worker_id" is not null and "supply_agreements"."supplier_id" is null)

supply_agreements_approved_ck.name: supply_agreements_approved_ck
supply_agreements_approved_ck.value: ("supply_agreements"."status" = 'approved') = ("supply_agreements"."approved_by" is not null and "supply_agreements"."approved_at" is not null)

worker_documents_dates_ck.name: worker_documents_dates_ck
worker_documents_dates_ck.value: "worker_documents"."issue_date" is null or "worker_documents"."expiry_date" is null or "worker_documents"."issue_date" <= "worker_documents"."expiry_date"

worker_sponsorships_own_ck.name: worker_sponsorships_own_ck
worker_sponsorships_own_ck.value: "worker_sponsorships"."engagement" <> 'own' or ("worker_sponsorships"."supply_agreement_id" is null and "worker_sponsorships"."authorisation_ref" is null)
